items.title: Oculomics using artificial intelligence derived retinal biomarkers for cardiovascular health
items.excerpt: Narrative review of how AI models reading retinal images (vascular morphology, OCT structure/perfusion, retinal age) link retinal biomarkers to cardiovascular risk factors, subclinical disease and clinical events - the oculomics case for eye-based cardiac screening.

items.title: A scoping review of bias in large AI models for medicine and healthcare
items.excerpt: Scoping review mapping where medical bias shows up in large AI models such as LLMs used in medicine - by demographic group, task and evaluation method - and the gaps in how clinical studies measure and mitigate it.

items.title: Large language models for depression assessment from brief daily diaries
items.excerpt: npj Digital Medicine study scoring depression severity from patients' brief free-text daily diaries with LLMs, as an alternative to repeated self-report questionnaires for intensive longitudinal tracking in clinical research and practice.

items.title: Artificial Intelligence-Enhanced Auscultation to Identify Left Ventricular Dysfunction - Development and External Validation in Prospective Multicenter Cohorts
items.excerpt: NEJM AI original article: an AI model on digital-stethoscope heart sounds detects left ventricular dysfunction at the point of care, developed and externally validated in prospective multicenter patient cohorts - a screening route for asymptomatic LVD where early treatment improves outcomes. (Online date via Crossref.)

items.title: AI-Assisted Molecular Review Refines SMO Inhibitor Candidacy in SHH Medulloblastoma
items.excerpt: NEJM AI case study: an AI-assisted molecular tumor review changed which patients with SHH-subtype medulloblastoma were judged candidates for SMO-inhibitor therapy - AI in oncology treatment selection. (Online date via Crossref.)

items.title: Effect of Previsit AI-Generated Document Summaries on Consultation Time and Patient-Physician Communication - The AI-INFOCARE Randomized Controlled Trial
items.excerpt: NEJM AI randomized trial (AI-INFOCARE) testing whether AI-generated summaries of patients' prior documents, prepared before the visit, shorten consultation time and change patient-physician communication. Note: close angle to the 10-18 NKI AI-FCP card. (Online date via Crossref.)

history_match.title: AI-supported first consultation preparation in oncology: a real-world clinical usability study

items.title: The Need to Clarify Regulation of Mental Health Artificial Intelligence
items.excerpt: JAMA Psychiatry Viewpoint on the potential dangers of mental health AI agents and therapy chatbots, and why regulators need to clarify how these tools are overseen. (Online date via Crossref created; RSS stamps issue date.)

items.title: Regulating AI Design to Prevent Youth Mental Health Harms
items.excerpt: JAMA Health Forum Viewpoint on poor mental health outcomes among youths who use AI chatbots, the AI safety design failures behind them, and design-level regulation to prevent harm. (Online date via Crossref.)

items.title: Reporting completeness of clinical trials evaluating large language model interventions in medicine: systematic review
items.excerpt: BMJ systematic review and meta-research study grading clinical trials of LLM interventions in medicine against established reporting guidelines (CONSORT-AI etc.), finding how completely they describe the model, prompts, and patient outcomes.

history_match.title: Standardized pre-consultation by a large language model agent vs ophthalmology residents: a randomized clinical trial

items.title: How much do language and context affect the accuracy of AI health advice?
items.excerpt: BMJ Health & Care Informatics study measuring how LLM health-advice accuracy varies across languages, health topics and question context - a patient-safety and equity check on chatbots people use for medical advice.

items.title: Artificial intelligence-enabled mental health applications for adolescents: a scoping review of safety, effectiveness and evidence
items.excerpt: BMJ Open scoping review mapping AI-enabled mental health apps for adolescents and separating the evidence on clinical effectiveness from the evidence on safety. (Online date via Crossref.)

items.title: AI matches radiologists at prostate cancer detection via MRI
items.excerpt: Radboud University-led research finds AI performs on par with radiologists at detecting clinically significant prostate cancer on MRI across diverse patient datasets, pitched as a way to automate parts of the MRI pathway amid workforce shortages. Check vs 10-14 SCARLET-1 card.

history_match.title: AI on par with radiologists for finding prostate cancer on MRI

items.title: Health and wellness company begins selling mammography AI directly to consumers for $249
items.excerpt: Everlywell rolled out FDA-authorized Clairity Breast nationwide: women upload a routine screening mammogram and pay $249 for an AI-predicted five-year breast cancer risk - a direct-to-consumer route for imaging AI.

history_match.title: Clairity expands access to AI breast cancer risk tool via Everlywell

items.title: SimBioSys Secures FDA Clearance for TumorSight Risk, the first AI-powered, MRI-derived breast cancer recurrence risk assessment
items.excerpt: FDA cleared SimBioSys's TumorSight Risk, AI software that estimates breast cancer recurrence risk from a patient's pre-surgery MRI. Off-list source: covered by ABC News / Diagnostic Imaging but not by any reachable allowed-domain outlet.

history_match.title: AIRS Medical secures FDA clearance for MRI software

items.title: 'AI sandboxes' are all the rage. Advocates scramble to control their future
items.excerpt: STAT Health Tech: as states set up regulatory 'AI sandboxes' for health AI pilots, trade groups, physician organizations and patient advocates are vying to shape the rules that would govern them.

history_match.title: Lobbyists and trade groups fight to shape how states regulate medical AI

items.title: AI will force doctors to focus on clinical reasoning, experts say
items.excerpt: At an Endpoints News panel, UCI Health's Pandita and Beth Israel's Rodman debated how tools like OpenEvidence are reshaping doctor skills, shifting training toward clinical reasoning over recall.

items.title: Why Agentic AI Works in Hospitals When You Strip It Down
items.excerpt: Hospitals running many simultaneous AI pilots to automate processes and free staff time; this piece argues agentic AI succeeds in hospital operations only when scoped down to narrow, well-defined tasks.

items.title: AI Native EMR 시대 여는 'BITMate AI' 선보인다
items.excerpt: 비트컴퓨터가 KIMES BUSAN 2026에서 AI 진료 에이전트 'BITMate AI'를 선보인다. 내원요약·보이스차팅·맞춤 AI 에이전트로 진료 중 대화 인식부터 기록 생성, 처방 흐름까지 실시간으로 잇는 의원·병원용 EMR이다.

items.title: "90도 다관절 원천 기술로 다빈치 넘을 것…'디지털 서저리' 새 기준 세운다"
items.excerpt: 리브스메드가 다관절 수술기구와 모듈형 수술로봇 '스타크'로 다빈치에 도전하며, 외과의 수술 데이터를 학습시킨 'AI 자율 수술' 연구를 국내 대학들과 진행 중이라고 밝혔다. AI 언급은 연구 계획 한 줄 수준이라 약한 후보.

items.title: 임상시험도 'AI 에이전트' 시대…통합 플랫폼 경쟁 본격화
items.excerpt: 임상시험에서 AI가 EDC·CTMS 단위 자동화를 넘어 시험기관 선정, 환자 등록, 데이터 검토, 규제 대응을 하나의 흐름으로 묶는 AI 에이전트 플랫폼 경쟁이 본격화하고 있다.
